question: Which edition of the Khelo India Youth Games was held in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**7th**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **7th edition** of the **Khelo India Youth Games (KIYG)** was scheduled to be held in the year **2025**.
 
• The state of **Bihar** was selected as the host for the **2025** edition, marking a significant milestone for the state in hosting national-level multi-sport events.
 
• The games aim to provide a platform for young athletes from across the **36 states and Union Territories** of India to compete in various sporting disciplines. ***Hence, the statement regarding the 7th edition is correct.***
